tickets.subject: SSO login loop for new team members
tickets.description: New engineers added to the BrightLoop workspace get redirected back to the login page after SSO completes. Existing users are unaffected.

comments.author: Alex Chen
comments.body: Reproduced in staging; looks like a stale SAML assertion cache. Investigating.

tickets.subject: Export job stuck at 92%
tickets.description: Large CSV export for the Q4 orders report has been stuck at 92% for 3 hours. Smaller exports complete normally.

tickets.subject: Request: increase API rate limit
tickets.description: Northfjord's nightly batch job occasionally hits the default rate limit. Requesting an increase to the enterprise tier limit.

comments.author: Alex Chen

tickets.subject: Dashboard shows wrong timezone for fleet events
tickets.description: Fleet event timestamps on the ops dashboard show UTC instead of the account's configured timezone (America/Los_Angeles).

comments.author: Jordan Blake
comments.body: Found the bug: dashboard widget ignored the account timezone setting. Fix deployed to staging.

comments.author: Jordan Blake
